title: dynamic-qa Quarantine Record v1
description: The Quarantine Record DESIGN-dynamic-qa-spec.md §5.6 and §12 describe: 'an explicit, expiring policy overlay' that 'leaves base Flow State, Freshness, and Enforcement State visible, routes the Binding to a named advisory lane, and blocks qualification.' Ticket #161. This document is the human-readable contract only — no JSON Schema validator dependency is added, matching every other schema in this bundle. The actual hand-written, fail-closed validation (including the business rules a plain schema cannot express, such as 'expiresAt must be after startAt' or 'both approval gates must be present') lives in shared/scripts/quarantine.mjs. A Quarantine Record is an OVERLAY: it never redeclares and structurally cannot write flowState, bindingFreshness, or enforcementState (see lifecycle-state.mjs, ticket #157) — none of those keys is even a legal member of this object (additionalProperties: false).

schema.description: Immutable. Any other value is an unsupported-schema-version error, never a silent upgrade.

quarantineId.description: Stable identifier for this Quarantine Record, distinct from the Diagnosis Record it attaches to.

bindingId.description: The exact Binding the exception applies to. Quarantine is scoped to a named Binding, never a whole portfolio or an unnamed set of tests.

diagnosisId.description: The Diagnosis Record (#158) this quarantine attaches to — quarantine follows a diagnosed failure, it never precedes or replaces one.

originatingFailureRef.description: Reference identifier for the originating Failure Evidence Bundle (#159 owns that schema; this field is only a stable pointer into it, never a copy of its content).

owner.description: Reuses diagnosis.mjs's Failure Owner enum verbatim — never redeclared.

failureClass.description: Reuses diagnosis.mjs's derived Failure Class enum verbatim — never redeclared.

trackedIssue.description: A stable http(s) URI to the tracked issue accepting this risk. Required — quarantine is never untracked.

acceptedRisk.description: Human-readable statement of the risk being knowingly accepted while this Binding is quarantined.

approvals.description: Reuses authority.mjs's qaOwnerGate/technicalOwnerGate shape verbatim. BOTH gates must be present — a single combined 'approved' field is rejected exactly as it is in the Setup Review Packet and Repair Review Packet.

expiresAt.description: Must be strictly after startAt. Defaults to startAt + 7 days when a caller does not supply one (createQuarantineRecord's job); once written, a record always carries an explicit value — nothing here reads an absent expiresAt as 'never expires'.

accountableOwner.description: The named human accountable for this exception (DESIGN-dynamic-qa-spec.md §8: 'the QA Owner owns... quarantine').

effectiveLane.description: The requested effective lane while quarantined. Always 'advisory', never 'required' — quarantine can only ever loosen a Binding's own CI gating for itself, and can never write provenance.mjs's real enforcementLane field.

evidence.description: Immutable at creation. No function in quarantine.mjs edits an existing record's evidence list — only createQuarantineRecord ever produces one, and it freezes both the array and every entry.
